name: hebb
description: Memory for Codex that learns from what actually happened: it catches commands your machine is known to fail on before they run, refuses the ones you banned, and remembers what you told it, across sessions and projects.

interface.shortDescription: Codex that learns from its own mistakes
interface.longDescription: Hebb watches which shell commands fail and what works instead, stops the known-bad command before it runs next time and hands Codex the one that works, enforces commands you have banned, and keeps a tamper-evident history. Everything stays on your machine.
